body: Back to draft for two small follow-ups from the review before merge: the viewport work-offset chip and height planes resolve the setup as `None` (first setup) instead of the shown operation's setup - against the rule that G54-G59 always comes from the operation's own setup - and the cleared-pick status text still says 'inferred offset'. Plus the empty `BREAKING CHANGE` footer commit. Re-reviewed and flagged ready again after.

Review findings addressed, plus the maintainer's wording clarification. New head 9369577.

**6a266d6** fix(ui): the viewport work-offset chip and height planes read the shown operation's setup
- `interact::shown_setup` returns the shown operation's own declared setup, or the active setup when the name is a draft. The chip and every `z_in` in `height_planes` now resolve in that setup. Nothing reads the first setup with `None` any more.
- Labels now show only the setup's word:
  - The Setups combo has a single `G54` entry, which merges "G54 (default)" and G54. An unset pick stays unset on disk, so the file format and goldens are unchanged.
  - The Heights row reads `G55  (from setup Setup2)`.
  - The status reads `Setup2 work offset: G54`. The "inferred offset" wording is gone.
- Note 3: `params.rs` now uses `u8::try_from(..).unwrap_or(u8::MAX)`.
- New tests in `crates/ui/src/setup_chip_tests.rs`:
  - `the_chip_and_planes_read_the_shown_operations_setup`: Setup2 picks G55, placed at Z -2. Its op shows `F2 · Clearance 23.00 (G55 +25.00)` and its plane stands at 23. Setup1's op shows G54 and its plane stands at 25, even with Setup2 active.
  - `a_draft_name_reads_the_active_setup`.
  - `setup_wcs_tests::an_unset_setup_reads_plain_g54`. The existing picker and Heights-row tests were updated to the new wording.

**9369577**: an empty `fix(setup)!:` commit carrying the BREAKING CHANGE footer (project files v52).

Gate:
- ui lib from CWD crates/ui: 289 passed, 2 ignored. No snapshot changes.
- app: setup_wcs 7, setup_defines_wcs 4, heights 11, heights_selection 9, posting 17, all passing.
- clippy `-D warnings` on app and ui: clean.

Left as a draft for re-review.

Fixed the re-review's blocker on the branch (still a draft): the setup sheet now prints the plain `program offset: G54` / `G58` (no 'default - not picked' / 'picked for this setup'); a refused offset change says 'work offset not changed'; the 'undo restores Auto' test note is gone. A scan of crates/app/src and crates/ui/src finds no other Auto/inferred/(default) wording around the work offset. Re-gated: app setup_wcs 7, setup_sheet 7, setup_defines_wcs 4, ui setup_* 7 - all pass; clippy -D warnings on app+ui clean.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 721a41f099a200fee03f5c7b5403451045e2bdf3 -->
Blocker: one user-facing work-offset string still carries the forbidden "default" wording.

Checked in 721a41f (diff from 9369577):
- `setup_sheet/sections.rs` prints `  program offset: <word>` only, G54 when unset (`unwrap_or(0)` into `WCS_SLOTS`). Fixed.
- `tests/setup_wcs.rs` assertions `"program offset: G54\n"` and `"program offset: G58\n"` are valid literals with `\n` on one line and assert the plain text. Fixed.
- `state.rs` refusal reads `work offset not changed: {err}`; the ui test asserts that text. Fixed.
- `ui/.../setup_wcs_tests.rs` note reads `undo restores G54 (unset)`; no "Auto". Fixed.

Blocker still present, `crates/app/src/commands/setup_wcs.rs` line 43 (`SetSetupWorkOffset::new`):
`slot.and_then(|i| WCS_SLOTS.get(i)).copied().unwrap_or("the default G54")` feeds the refusal `setup '<name>' already posts at the default G54`. This is a user-visible CommandError (status line and MCP), and it is the "(default)" wording the maintainer ruled out. Fix: `unwrap_or("G54")`, so the text reads `already posts at G54`.

Non-blocking, code comments only: `schema.rs:129` ("not picked") and `commands/setup_wcs.rs:3` ("the `G54` default"), `project/file.rs:44` ("the inferred law"). They are not printed.

Branch grep (`not picked|picked for this setup|inferred offset|(default)|Auto`) on the work-offset paths shows no other user-facing hits. The Auto hits are CycleChoice, Side, and PocketStrategy, which are unrelated.

Not rebuilt; relied on the author's gate run. `mergeable` was UNKNOWN when I checked. Labels and draft state are left as they are.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 0e06a0e855c9ecaaceb7e3b7433bf5b199a74c9e -->
Clean - ready to merge

Re-checked 721a41f -> 0e06a0e. The only change is `crates/app/src/commands/setup_wcs.rs` line 43: the refusal fallback now reads `unwrap_or("G54")`, so an already-set refusal says `already posts at G54`. That closes the blocker from the previous review.

Jargon grep over `crates/app/src` and `crates/ui/src` for work-offset paths (`not picked`, `picked for this setup`, `inferred offset`, `(default)`, `default G54`, `Auto` near offset/WCS/setup) returns no hits. The earlier comment-only hits in `schema.rs`, `commands/setup_wcs.rs:3`, and `project/file.rs:44` are code comments and not printed.

Build and tests were not rerun; I relied on the author's run (`setup_wcs` 7 passed, clippy `-D warnings` clean on camcraft-app). `mergeable` is MERGEABLE.
